scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external lucide-react
scripts.dev: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external lucide-react --watch
